task_description: Add an available-when-supported New York wedding forecast widget and persistent accessible dark mode to the existing wedding itinerary site.

verification.summary: The Friday countdown now presents its remaining-day value at a substantially larger responsive size with accessible, honest before, during, and after-event messaging. Production validation passed, all 23 Node tests passed, and real-browser checks passed at 320px and 1280px in light and dark modes. No Dockerfile exists.
